changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 6 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/10106-settled-schema-equal-payload.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > The hook refetches `getObjectSchema` whenever the adapter identity changes, and every consumer its doc comment instructs — `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectView`, `ObjectTimeline`, `ObjectGallery` — keys its record fetch on the returned `def`, which is what `AGENTS.md` §5 commandment #10 tells a consumer to do (key on the payload, never on a memo identity). The producer half of that same sentence is what this fixes: a byte-identical answer arriving as a fresh object re-fired every one of those fetches, and the duplicate query carried the same `$expand` set as the one before it. Measured first-hand on `ObjectGantt` with an instrumented adapter, with a control swap in the same command; the counts, and the control that makes them a discrimination rather than a counting artefact, are asserted by `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useSettledSchema.equalPayload-10106.test.tsx` (objectui#10106).

### `.changeset/5674-retire-plugin-component-input.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > **Why now, and why a `minor` rather than waiting further.** The deprecation window exists to warn a consumer outside this repository, unmeasurable from here, before a published export disappears. That window has already been spent — stage 1 shipped and the warning has been live. The follow-up card that was meant to gate stage 2 on "a release actually shipping the deprecation" was later closed as a duplicate into a release-batch tracking card that itself no longer exists (answers 404), so the gate had no carrier left to clear. Execution ruling 2026-09-27 (triage, carrying the maintainer's 「同意」) deletes now rather than block indefinitely on a dead gate; the sibling `objectstack` repository's `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈阶段姿态〉 already makes immediate retirement (no alias, no window) the default disposition for a zero-consumer published name. Removing a published export is `minor`, not `patch` — this repo's own breaking changes never declare `major` (see `AGENTS.md`'s version-alignment policy).

### `.changeset/6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > `bind` was read by ten production sites and declared by no schema shape. It resolved as `any` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and rode `.passthrough()` on the validator, while three separate documents taught it as an authorable key of *every* node: this repo's own `AGENTS.md` §4 ("Every node in the UI tree follows this shape (`@object-ui/types`)"), the published agent-facing `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ("Every UI component node MUST follow this shape"), and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. So the agent-facing protocol told authors to write a key the published types did not know existed.

### `.changeset/6505-predicate-valued-gate-rules.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > **The accept set widens to what the protocol already declares and the runtime already accepts, not beyond it.** `AGENTS.md` §4 declares both keys as expressions, `SchemaRenderer` evaluates them through `hasDeclaredPredicate` + `evaluateCondition`, `@objectstack/spec` normalizes every authored predicate into a `{ dialect, source }` envelope, and the objectui#3862 / objectui#3955 rulings are entirely about which expression spellings count as declared. This table was the one place in the repo that disagreed, so this restores declared = enforced rather than changing a contract.

### `.changeset/7122-spec-17-3-0-parity-reconciliation.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > Two breaking consequences for a consumer that names the type directly. **(1)** It no longer declares `editMode`; the key is now carried by the spec's `ServiceObject`, so `ObjectSchemaMetadata` still has it, but code written against the extension type ALONE loses it. **(2)** `interface` → type alias also ends **declaration merging**: a consumer that reopened `declare module '@object-ui/types' { interface ObjectSchemaClientExtensions { … } }` to add its own client-side member no longer compiles, because an alias cannot be reopened. `minor` rather than `major` per `AGENTS.md`'s version-alignment rule — objectui's own breaking changes are graded `minor` with the semantics stated in the body, since any `major` in the fixed group would push all 39 packages off `@objectstack`'s major.

### `.changeset/7714-lookup-draft-stays-client-side.md`

- names `AGENTS.md` → `AGENTS.md` — edited by this change

  > `minor` rather than `major` per `AGENTS.md`: objectui's major tracks `@objectstack`'s, so objectui's own breaking changes ship as `minor` with the breaking semantics stated.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `29c76e573` (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1669 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2264 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36399685076)

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位 `domain:devx` @ objectui 第 2 席(`session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`)对照本 PR 的实际 diff(head `4259546da5`)校正 dev 草稿后定稿;复核记录在 objectui#9441 评论。

**改了什么**:在 objectui 根目录 `AGENTS.md` 的「多 agent 协作纪律」一节加一条(+5 行,仅此一个文件):agent 的提交信息结尾统一用两行不带模型名的署名(会话链接 + 通用的 `Co-authored-by: Claude`),PR、评论、changeset、文档和代码注释里也不写模型名。正文逐字照抄 objectstack 仓 `AGENTS.md` 的同一条规则,只删掉「由 pre-push 钩子拦截」那半句;另加一句提醒:本仓没有任何机械拦截,靠 harness 自己「让位于 AGENTS.md」的优先级生效。

**为什么改**:objectstack 早已写明这条规则,objectui 的 `AGENTS.md` 却一字未提,在本仓干活的 agent 会照着工具的默认提示写上模型名;而 squash 合并会把这行署名原样带进 `main` 的历史,事后不改写。本卡 9 月 18 日经总监席呈报、您同意的是方案 A:只补文字,不加钩子、不加门禁。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改给 agent 读的说明文字,不碰代码、测试、构建或发版。代价:本仓仍无机械拦截,效果取决于 agent 读到并照做;两个仓各存一份同文规则,改一边要记得同步另一边。回滚:revert 本 PR 唯一的 commit 即可。

**席位意见**:建议批准。席位独立核对了引文:objectstack 原段落去掉那半句后与本 PR 的引文逐字节一致;diff 只有这 5 行,与裁决 A 的范围一致。额外那句「本仓无强制」的提醒属实,也是本仓诫条 #9 要求的写法。CI 在席位复核时(07:44Z)Lint、Type Check、Build & E2E、Changeset Declaration 已绿,8 个测试分片仍在跑;落地前席位会再确认全绿。同文件的下一张卡(objectui#9666,强制推送那句)排在本 PR 之后串行。

**你要做的**:在本 PR 上点 Approve(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 任一账号即可);之后翻 ready、入队由席位完成。

- The failure: `packages/types` `type-check` — `report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`, TS1360 `Type 'true' does not satisfy the expected type 'false'`, compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `df3ba164`. That pin is a designed tripwire: objectstack `681868ca` (objectstack#20369) typed `JoinedReportBlock`, so `IsUnknown` flipped. This PR changes `AGENTS.md` only (+5/−0) and cannot move it.
- Same signature on other PRs of this hour (objectui#10912, #10915, #10921), green on `main` at 06:50Z ⇒ one incident, anchored on objectui#10916 (claimed as a maintainer-authorised stop-the-bleed); ⛔ no second card. No fix PR exists yet, so there is nothing to port, and porting a `packages/types` change into this governed docs PR would duplicate the anchor's hunk.
- No re-run: the failure is deterministic against objectstack `main` and already reproduced on four heads.
- Every other check on this head is green (`Lint` · `Type Check` · `Test` · `Build & E2E` · `Build Docs` · `Changeset Declaration` · `Governed Surface Queue Guard`); `os-zhuang` approved this head and armed auto-merge. Once objectui#10916's fix is on `main`, this seat merges `main` into this branch (the ruleset requires an up-to-date branch) and follows it to MERGED.

## Contract review

Post-hoc: this PR merged before the contract-tier review it owed; this record is that review, taken after landing.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `55e0f36535c6fb51cbc76598e07526943a5f31f8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read, reading taken 2026-09-28T11:10Z: card objectui#9441 (body and all six comments, the ruling 5724938982 included), PR objectui#10922 (body, its three comments, file list, net diff against `main`), the 40 check-runs on the head; file text at the named commits through `git show`; the sister paragraph from objectstack `origin/main` `AGENTS.md`. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Diff shape: one file, root `AGENTS.md`, +5/−0, one bullet in `### 多 agent 协作纪律(并行修改本仓库,务必遵守)` placed right after the 「每次 commit/push 前先确认当前分支」 bullet. The head is a merge of `main` (base `29c76e573c`) into the branch; its net diff equals the API diff and the squash commit `af2221d45e`'s diffstat, and `AGENTS.md` at the head is byte-identical to `AGENTS.md` at `af2221d45e` on `main`.

1. **Ruling fidelity** (5724938982, letter A): objectui `AGENTS.md` gains the same two sentences — the model-free pair, the pre-push refusal NOT ported, the two exemptions — in its multi-agent discipline section, text only, no hook. On the diff: both sentences present, the pre-push clause absent, both exemptions present, section as ruled, nothing but `AGENTS.md` in the file list, so no hook and no gate. MATCH.
2. **Quote fidelity, re-derived here rather than taken from the PR:** the paragraph of objectstack `origin/main` `AGENTS.md` (tip `24b7085939`; wording unchanged since the dev's `df3ba164`) that begins `**Commit message:**`, whitespace-flattened, with the clause `, and the pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in that pair` removed (it occurs exactly once), compares strictly equal to the blockquote line at the head: byte-equal, 474 characters. No other word changed, nothing translated.
3. **Factual claims in the added warning**, each checked against the head tree or the live objects:
   - 「没有 pre-push 钩子,也没有读提交信息的门禁」 — TRUE. At the head: no `.githooks/`, `.husky/`, lefthook or simple-git-hooks file; `package.json` carries no husky / lefthook / simple-git-hooks / hooksPath / prepare / pre-push / pre-commit / commitlint key; `.claude/hooks/` holds three PreToolUse guards (main-checkout, shared-stash, tree-enum) and their self-tests, none of which reads a commit message; no file outside `AGENTS.md` names `Co-authored-by`, `Claude-Session`, `hooksPath` or a model name; no workflow parses commit text. Control leg: the objectstack tree carries the pre-push hook and `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs`.
   - 「harness 的署名提醒让位于 `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` 里关于这几行的规则」 — TRUE. The harness attribution reminder, as served to this very session, states that the user's own instructions about these lines, such as a CLAUDE.md or memory rule, take precedence over the reminder, and that no line the reminder leaves out is added — the model-free pair adds none, it changes only the co-author's name. objectui's `CLAUDE.md` delegates to `AGENTS.md` in one line, so the rule reaches the reminder through it. Demonstrated on this PR: the branch commit `4259546da5` ends with `Claude-Session:` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude` (the noreply address) and no model name, while the reminder had asked for a model-named co-author.
   - The quoted ruling sentence 「The harness's own precedence rule does the enforcing.」 is verbatim from 5724938982.
   - 「squash 入队保留 `Co-authored-by`……原样落进 `main` 的历史」 — TRUE, now measured on this PR's own landing: the squash commit `af2221d45e` on `main` carries `Co-authored-by: Claude` (the noreply address) verbatim from `4259546da5`, plus a second `Co-authored-by` for the update-branch merge's author, and no model identifier. It carries no `Claude-Session:` line; the added text does not claim it does (see ③).
4. **Conflicts within the file:** none found. Commandment #-1 allows Chinese in operational sections and §9 is one; commandment #11 is met — the bullet cites by content anchor (`**Commit message:**`) and by comment id, no `path:line`, and `Line Citation Gate` is `success` on the head; commandment #9 is met — the warning names what does not enforce the rule instead of writing a count (the dev's 40-of-40 reading stays out of the file, as the PR body says); §0's "commit messages in English" holds, the pair is English. The file's earlier choice to keep only a pointer to a different objectstack paragraph (the body-bytes rule) was a per-rule choice; here the ruling itself ordered the two sentences copied, and the drift cost is stated in the PR's 维护者速读. The file already quotes the sibling repo verbatim elsewhere (the os-dev.md delivery sentences in the same section).

### ② Semver level

The diff publishes nothing: root `AGENTS.md` sits in no package's `files` list and is not `src/` of any package in the `fixed` release group. Under the file's own §9 Housekeeping rule no changeset is owed, and `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are `success` on the head. The PR body's `Clause-②: no` carries no arm — well-formed under the closed form (`yes|no` plus at most one of `(widening)` / `(narrowing)`), and `no` with no changeset is exactly what a diff that publishes nothing declares.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 5865617148: `open_questions` is empty. Four `deviations` and one `out_of_scope_findings` entry, each answered:

- **D1** reader-test set taken from the `markdown-test-inputs` ledger rather than a grep — ACCEPTED. The ledger is the instrument that names the file's readers (commandment #9's shape); the two grep-only hits use the string as a path or fixture, not the file's bytes; and every `Test` shard on the head is `success`, which covers them regardless.
- **D2** gates run as `node scripts/NAME.mjs` — ACCEPTED. Those are the commands the `check:*` wrappers invoke, and the CI workflow for each (Control Byte Scan, Line Citation Gate, Shell Escape Residue Scan, Internal Docs Link Check, Changeset Declaration, Governed Surface Queue Guard) is `success` on the head.
- **D3** the warning added beyond the two quoted sentences — ACCEPTED. It stays inside ruling A (text only, no hook; it quotes the ruling's own enforcement sentence), commandment #9 asks for it, and every claim in it is verified TRUE in ①.3.
- **D4** the harness reminder asked for a model-named co-author and the commit used the model-free pair — ACCEPTED, not a deviation. Verified on `4259546da5`; that precedence is what the ruling relies on and what the diff writes down.
- **Out-of-scope observation** (carrier: the landing seat) — the reading it asked for now exists and is recorded here for objectui#9666's carrier to pick up: the squash composer KEPT `Co-authored-by` and DROPPED `Claude-Session:` (the branch commit carried both; `af2221d45e` carries only the former). Not this card's; this record writes nothing to objectui#9666.

Gate verdicts on the head: 40 check-runs, 37 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, and the coverage-shard matrix placeholder entry — conditional jobs, not failures), 0 failure. `Spec Main Shape Gate` is `success` on this head after the objectui#10916 unlock; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success`.

Post-hoc note: the landing route (an `os-zhuang` approval on the Tier H surface, then the owning seat through the queue) is the card's business; this record supplies only the review the PR owed and changes nothing on `main`.
